# v0.10.0b6 — Targets that end with the charge

- **Breaking:** the saved control state of 0.10.0b5 is not read. After the update the app switches the charging release off and blocks charging commands until you confirm the reset under **Settings → System → Repairs**; then set your targets again.
- A reached energy or cost target ends when the car is unplugged, together with any pause, so the next car charges without the previous limit.
- The departure plan's current no longer replaces the current you chose: a pause and resume after the plan return to yours.
- A percentage target that the car's lower charge limit pressed down returns to your chosen value when the limit rises again; a target picked at the top of the scale keeps following the limit.
- Many fixes from a full review: guest charging next to the departure plan, Virtual Plug & Charge releases around refused commands, a serial port reopened by the owner only, late heartbeats logged once per weak phase, and Home Assistant options that change in place.

Update the app and the integration to **0.10.0b6** together. The cost target and these rules are not yet tested on real hardware.

Every contribution is voluntary and very welcome; support and new features stay open to everyone either way.
